output:
Yes, but it breaks the repo's first release invariant, and pre-launch is the only cheap time to do it.

macOS ties Accessibility and Microphone grants to the bundle identifier. After the rename, every existing install becomes a new app to the system: dictation stops working until the user re-grants both, and preferences reset unless we migrate them.

My recommendation is to keep `is.waiwai.dictation`. Users never see it, and the app name can be OpenRamble regardless.

If existing installs are just you and a few testers and you want the clean ID, say so. I'd rename it and update the rules file to make the new one permanent.
